Required method: trace entrypoints, module reachability, distinct responsibilities, clone/wrapper/filler risk, cross-module invariants, a ~25% removal test, and data/state consumption versus logic. large_system_strict PASS also forbids HIGH toy or padding risk.
Software/Systems Python streaming task; artifacts ["/app/sessions"]; separate verifier; workdir /app. The 3000-line floor is not stated in this TOML.
Design record binds profile=large_system_strict only. Defect lists and creator claims were not treated as Q6 conclusions.
Operator entrypoint sets PYTHONPATH and execs python3 -m src.cli. This is the sole public runtime root used for the import-closure walk (4 non-blank non-comment lines).

main() loads processor.json, recovered journal/open state, and TenantDirectory; refuses to run when catalog_ready() is false; decodes --input/--feed; orders events; calls process_events; then finalize_run. Starter defects (touch/reset of journal before argparse) sit on a real operator path, not a stub.

Per-event loop binds tenant-effective config, classifies lateness, applies session assignment, appends a journal line, then watermark-closes idle sessions and snapshots open state. bind_config(...) is consumed as cfg_eff, not discarded.

PLAN_GAP_MS overlays enterprise session_gap_ms=45000; standard/internal keep processor.json. bind_config returns a new ProcessorConfig used by classify/assign/close. Lab tenants absent from the catalog keep all three knobs.
TenantDirectory.refresh loads SQLite tenant/user/coverage/plan mix/rollups. catalog_ready() is a hard CLI fence. observe() records per-event activity that finalize writes into ops-report.

Successful runs always compose ops-report.json (catalog, inventory, journal integrity, snapshot health, warehouse reconcile) and persist_desk last_run.json. Those files are contracted operator outputs, not unused sidecars.
compose_last_run copies inventory_snapshot event/tenant/user counts into warehouse.event_count and attaches coverage/plan_mix. That is the last_run.json schema the contract requires.

session_key currently returns ('*', user_id), so SessionStore/SessionKeyedState lookups collide across tenants. The keyed-state backend is real; the identity bug is load-bearing, not a constant-output shell.

WatermarkTrack.record overwrites max_observed with the current event; peek_comparison uses comparison_watermark. Pipeline records before classify. These are interacting event-time defects on a real tracker, not a lookup table.

append_journal encodes watermark_ms/max_observed/seq then write_text (truncate) with seq stuck at 1. load_journal parses the JSONL prefix via journal_codec. Persistence and restart are present; the append/seq bugs are the work.

Codec validates typed integer fields, contiguous seq, nondecreasing watermarks, formula watermark_ms = max_observed - allowed_lateness, and last-line/state match. Used from load and from finalize journal_health_report.

decide_on_time_close branches duration vs gap; when use_arrival_gap is true it consults arrival_gap_exceeded (arrival_index*1000) instead of event_time. CLI always passes use_arrival_gap=True, so --input inherits the arrival-gap defect.

classify_lateness returns on_time / late_allowed / too_late from watermark membership and late_join_eligible (open session, same identity, event inside [start, last+gap)). Distinct from gap assignment.
read_events scans JSONL, rejects malformed/missing/typed/negative event_time lines, and returns Event objects. Fail-closed rejects.jsonl is a real ingest path.
order_for_mode sorts --input by (event_time_ms, tenant_id, user_id, event_id) and preserves --feed file order. Two independent ordering contracts share the same decoder.

SessionStore is a thin facade over SessionKeyedState, which itself wraps PartitionedMap. The identity/partition behavior is real; the extra pass-through layer is modest wrapper padding, not the bulk of the closure.

inventory_snapshot computes schema_ok from required click_event columns and COUNT aggregates used by catalog_ready and last_run warehouse.event_count. Repeated GROUP BY helpers in coverage.py/rollups.py feed ops-report; they are similar SQL skeletons with different keys, not one giant constant table.
50 non-blank non-comment DDL lines for tenant, click_user, ingest_batch, click_event, indexes, and processor_run. Runtime catalog schema, not seed inserts.
Five-line runtime config: session_gap_ms=30000, allowed_lateness_ms=10000, max_session_duration_ms=3600000. Loaded every run via src.config.

Contracted outputs include last_run.json warehouse.event_count, ops-report.json catalog.available and inventory.event_count, and catalog-backed enterprise session_gap overlay. Catalog/ops code is therefore production behavior, not optional decoration.

Image-build RUN python3 /app/sessions/tools/generate_seed.py writes ledger, seed.sql, and catalog.sqlite. generate_seed.py is not on the src.cli import graph and was excluded from reachable runtime LOC.

MAJOR_MODULES.state_error_behavior: Unknown flags and missing --input/--feed/--empty-check should exit 2 before mutation; starter currently touches/resets the journal first. catalog_ready failure exits 2. Successful paths always finalize operator reports.

MAJOR_MODULES.state_error_behavior: Malformed JSON, missing fields, wrong types, empty ids, and negative event_time_ms become rejects.jsonl records; valid events carry line_no into the pipeline.

MAJOR_MODULES.responsibility: Per-event orchestration: lateness class, on-time close/reopen, too-late emit, empty-check outputs, duplicate-close guard.
MAJOR_MODULES.state_error_behavior: Mutates SessionStore, counters, sessions.jsonl, late.jsonl, journal, and open_sessions.json. CloseLog suppresses duplicate closed identities.

PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Writing tenant_id onto open_sessions.json while session_key still returns ('*', user_id) keeps cross-tenant lookup collisions.
Clamping comparison watermark at 0, or classifying after WatermarkTrack.record overwrite, still rewinds max_observed and mislabels lateness.
Incrementing seq in memory while append_journal still uses write_text leaves a one-line journal and breaks restart prefix/seq.
Rejecting unknown flags after _touch_runtime/_reset_outputs still creates or clears watermark.journal; --reset-output must not truncate the journal.
Turning gap off, or closing after a fixed event count, can match one fixture while session_gap_ms from processor.json and the enterprise overlay still fail.
Sorting --feed like --input hides arrival-order lateness; sorting --input only by event_id still permutes equal-time (tenant, user) ties.
Hard-coding session_gap_ms=45000 for every tenant breaks lab feeds that must keep processor.json; skipping catalog_ready still fails last_run warehouse.event_count / ops-report inventory.event_count.
Watermark-triggered closes use per-session bind_config, so repairing only the on-time assign path leaves enterprise idle closes on the processor.json gap.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing about 25% of the reachable core cannot leave claimed behavior intact. Dropping windows/late/engine (~500 nbc) removes gap, duration, lateness, and close emission. Dropping runtime/state journal+snapshot (~490 nbc) removes restart, seq, and watermark persistence. Dropping tenancy+catalog fence/overlay plus ops finalize (~900+ nbc) removes catalog_ready, enterprise session_gap, last_run.json, and ops-report.json, which the contract requires on every successful run. The removable unused helpers (~189) plus re-export barrels (~151) and SessionStore/checkpoint facades are well under 25% and would not by themselves keep the system looking complete. seed.sql and click_ledger.jsonl are data, not this removal budget.
